description: The operator-owned model catalog. It names every model the fabric may pull, which node may serve it, the quant, the runtime, the license and the approximate fit. Weights are not knowledge, not authority and never enter a vault, a bundle or 4223. The Master host (agx64, 64 GB) serves the teacher; the peer host (agx32, 32 GB) serves the student. The teacher is deliberately not eligible for agx32: a 32 GB node cannot serve it, and a cold backup of those weights there is not a deployment.

store.note: The store is a host path, never a vault path. A model pull is an operator action; it is not an LLM tool.

master.why: The 64 GB Master host is the only node that can hold the teacher with context headroom. The Master uses it for authority-plane reasoning and distillation, not user chat.

peer.why: The 32 GB peer host trains and serves the smaller same-family student model for user chat.

models.why: The newest open-weight MoE that fits agx64. The n-gram table stays on NVMe; fast memory is about 45.8 GB. Benchmark before promoting.
models.runtime_note: Blocked on the current stack: Ollama 0.32.13 / the image llama.cpp does not provide qwen4exp support. Do not download the 85 GB build until a qwen4exp-capable runtime is selected.

models.why: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M; the same-version teacher for the 27B student. The official unsloth GGUF is the benchmark source.
models.notes: Operator-selected winner of the Step 109 bake-off: teacher throughput 18.54/18.08 tok/s, student 4.41/4.54 tok/s, quality 1.0.

models.why: Quality reference for the bake-off. It fits 64 GB but leaves less room than Q4_K_M for the peer's other services.
models.notes: Live quality reference 2026-11-01: 17.79 tok/s, 34.39 GiB resident, 100% on the fixed suite (thinking off). Needs vLLM/aux stopped.

models.why: The smallest Qwen3.8 generation model. It fits agx32 for inference, but QLoRA training is tight; use only in an exclusive training window.
models.notes: Retired by Step 108: not the same Qwen version as the Qwen3.6 teacher. Keep the weights until the new student is validated; do not use the pair for distillation.

models.why: The safe default student: same Qwen family, comfortable QLoRA on 32 GB, and leaves room for the Master's services.
